title: A content panel that lives in your repository
subtitle: Schema-driven forms, per-language content, drag-and-drop blocks and a visual page builder. Your content stays as plain files; every save is a commit.

features.title: Git is the backend
features.text: Content stays as JSON and Markdown in your repository. Every save is one commit under the editor's own GitHub account. No database, no hosted service.

features.title: Schema in code
features.text: One definition drives the panel's forms and the reader that builds your site, so what the panel writes and what the site reads cannot drift.

features.title: Real translations
features.text: One file per language, language tabs, and the source text shown under every field you translate. You choose which fields.

features.title: Drag and drop
features.text: Lists and typed blocks sort by dragging. Changes to a list in the default language are mirrored into the translations.

features.title: Visual page builder
features.text: Draw pages with your own block components, add blocks from a palette, edit the selected block in a side panel.

features.title: Images and media
features.text: Paste a link or upload to any S3-compatible bucket (S3, R2, MinIO …) or straight into the repo, with a media library to browse them.

features.title: Validation and drafts
features.text: Rules enforced on the server and shown in the panel. Optionally publish through pull requests with a review page.

features.title: Framework-agnostic
features.text: The server is a (Request) => Response function; adapters for Next.js and Node. The panel is one React component.

features.title: Make it yours
features.text: Custom editors and field widgets render your data your way, using the panel's own building blocks.
